snippet.title: Super Mario Bros. 2 (NES) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of Nintendo's 1988 platformer for the NES, Super Mario Bros. 2.

This video has since been replaced by a new 4K playthrough which can be found at https://youtu.be/styOUlsS8-o
_____________
No cheats were used during the recording of this video. 

NintendoComplete (http://www.nintendocomplete.com/) punches you in the face with in-depth reviews, screenshot archives, and music from classic 8-bit NES games!
